info.name: Gazebo - Product Images
info.description:
# Gazebo Product Images

Multiple photos per catalog item, with **one main photo**. Floor UI can scroll `images[]`; recipe tree uses `image_url` (main, else category photo).

**Table:** `product_image` (S3 prefix `Product/{product_id}/`)

## Routes
`GET|POST /product/:id/images/`, `GET|PATCH|DELETE /product/images/:id/`

## Auth
1. Run **Login** in Gazebo - RBAC Users (`POST /auth/login/`)
2. Copy `data.id_token` into `{{id_token}}`
3. All routes need `Authorization: Bearer {{id_token}}`

## Envelope
Success: `{ "status": "success", "message": "...", "data": ... }`
Error: `{ "status": "error", "message": "...", "data": null }`

## Vars
`{{base_url}}`, `{{id_token}}`, `{{product_id}}`, `{{image_id}}`

item.name: Product Images
item.description:
CRUD for item photos. First upload is main. Set another as main with PATCH. Deleting the main photo promotes the next by `sort_order`.

**Table:** `product_image`

**Vars:** `{{product_id}}`, `{{image_id}}`

request.description:
### List product images

`GET /product/:id/images/`

Returns every photo for this item, main first, then `sort_order`. Use this list for the scrolling gallery. `url` is a 1-hour S3 presign.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | Product PK |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Product images fetched successfully.`

`data.count` and `data.results[]`:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Image PK |
| `product_id` | Product PK |
| `is_main` | True for the hero photo |
| `sort_order` | Gallery order among non-main (and after main) |
| `original_filename` | Upload name |
| `url` | Presigned GET URL, or null |
| `created_at` | ISO timestamp |

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | List returned (empty `results` if none) |
| 404 | Product not found or inactive |
| 401 | Not signed in |

formdata.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Under 20 MB.
true makes this the hero photo. First photo is always main.

request.description:
### Upload product image

`POST /product/:id/images/`

Adds a photo to the item. JPEG / PNG / WebP. Stored privately in S3 under `Product/{id}/`. The first photo on an item is always main. Send `is_main=true` to replace the current hero.

Example: potato dice raw material — first shot is the bag photo (`is_main` true by default); extra angle shots stay in the scroller.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | Product PK |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

`multipart/form-data`:

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | yes | Image file (`file` or `image`) |
| `is_main` | no | `true` / `false`. Default false. Forced true if this is the first photo |
| `sort_order` | no | Integer gallery order. Default 0 |

### Response body

`message`: `Product image uploaded successfully.`

`data`: one image object (`id`, `product_id`, `is_main`, `sort_order`, `original_filename`, `url`, `created_at`). Test script saves `id` to `{{image_id}}`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 201 | Photo stored |
| 400 | Missing file, unsupported type, too large, or bad `sort_order` / `is_main` |
| 404 | Product not found or inactive |
| 401 | Not signed in |

### Get product image

`GET /product/images/:id/`

One photo row plus a fresh presigned `url`.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `product_image` PK |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Product image fetched successfully.`

`data`: `id`, `product_id`, `is_main`, `sort_order`, `original_filename`, `url`, `created_at`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Found |
| 404 | Image missing, or parent product inactive |
| 401 | Not signed in |

### Update product image

`PATCH /product/images/:id/`

Set this photo as the hero (`is_main: true`) and/or change gallery `sort_order`. Setting main unsets the previous main. You cannot set `is_main: false` on the current hero — PATCH another photo to `is_main: true` instead.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `product_image` PK |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `is_main` | no | `true` makes this the hero. `false` on the current hero is rejected |
| `sort_order` | no | Integer gallery order |

### Response body

`message`: `Product image updated successfully.`

`data`: the updated image object.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Updated |
| 400 | Invalid JSON, bad `is_main`/`sort_order`, or attempted to clear the only main |
| 404 | Image missing, or parent product inactive |
| 401 | Not signed in |

### Delete product image

`DELETE /product/images/:id/`

Removes the photo and the S3 object. If it was main, the next remaining photo (`sort_order`, then `id`) becomes main.

### Path parameters

| Param | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | `product_image` PK |

### Query parameters

None.

### Request body

**None**.

### Response body

`message`: `Product image deleted successfully.`  
`data`: `null`.

### Status codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| 200 | Deleted |
| 404 | Image missing, or parent product inactive |
| 401 | Not signed in |
